text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~!! This is the 'Elder Great Tree'!
It's just as big as they said on TV...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's start from here! First, a wide shot—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan! Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. This is a trendy photo spot lately.
In other words... the perfect spot to photobomb!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Photobombing...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, as a rule, photobombing should be done in moderation.
If it would bother you, Craft—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...!! Chan-san and the tree stand so gently together... they match perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're not in the way at all!
In fact, I'd love for you to model for me!
Please, pretty please...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The way you just looked up!
With the sunlight filtering through the trees reflected in your eyes—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just staying natural might be best!
Keep that sparkle just the way it is~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... It's already this late.
Sorry, I got a little too carried away with the details...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still... look! Miss Chan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. The cute Chan-Ma and
the deeply rooted, mighty tree are having a rendezvous.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Taiki-san... You really are big, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how long it has lived
to grow this big."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: They said on TV that it was several thousand years old!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A few thousand years, huh... That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Living for so many years and meeting all kinds of people sounds like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—!
...Machan just had an epiphany.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want to live a long life and meet lots of people, so they'll remember Machan's face.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, someday I will become a beloved symbol
just like Taiki-san. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that's so like Chan-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Someday, even when we're old ladies, shall we come here again?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Taiki-san is waiting for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—!
Ehehe... got it! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's what happened.
I'll be going to visit Taiki-san again sometime.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I will take a picture with Craft-san and Taiki-san.
Since the three of us couldn't take one this time."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Our memories.
I'll show them to you later, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, let's definitely go together.
Not to see photos, but to meet in person.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Someday, all together.
